title: Badges contract
description: Language-neutral badge shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. awardedBadge mirrors the Firestore `users/{uid}/badges/{badgeKey}` document (document ID = badge key; catalog definition denormalized). The catalog itself lives in functions/src/badges/badge-core.ts (single source of truth, ported from the legacy badge-catalog): wording stays positive and non-competitive, no speed/distance/racing badges, all user-facing text in Swedish. Badges are backend-awarded only and never revoked. Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

badgeKey.description: Canonical badge keys. helpful_member is the only manually awardable key; the rest are automatic.

iconIdentifier.description: Opaque icon reference for the client UI.

awardedByUserId.description: Awarding admin UID for admin_manual awards; null for automatic.

awardHelpfulMemberRequest.description: Input for badges.awardHelpfulMember (admin-only). The reason is required and lands in the adminAuditEvents record, never on the badge document.
